title: Huntington Fed. Savings Bank
meta_description: Huntington Fed’s mobile app is a great tool when you need financial freedom.
full_description: HFSB Mobile Banking is FREE application. With this secure app you can easily access online banking, and use the following features:-Check account balances-Review account history-Pay bills with Bill Pay-Transfer money between accounts with HFSB -Receive and Send money to other people-Find Branches, and ATMsHuntington Federal’s mobile banking is a great tool when you need financial freedom.  Your information is available to use 24/7… including holidays.   Sensitive user information is transmitted via secure channels for your privacy and protection. Sessions are encrypted and devices are authenticated every time you access your accounts. No data is stored on your phone and users are logged off automatically for safety and convenience.  If you’re a Huntington Federal Customer download the app today.If you have any questions, contact a Huntington Federal representative for help 304-528-6209
